# Gov.cn: Renewable energy accounts for 56% of China's total installed capacity

Published: 28 Jan 2025. Xinhua.

## Key Findings
- 2024 new renewable capacity: **373 million kW**, up **23% YoY**.
  - Hydro: 13.78 million kW
  - Wind: 79.82 million kW
  - Solar: 278 million kW
  - Biomass: 1.85 million kW
- New renewables = **86% of total new installed power capacity** in 2024.
- Cumulative renewable capacity end 2024: **1.889 billion kW (1,889 GW)**, up **25% YoY**.
  - Hydro: 436 GW, Wind: 521 GW, Solar: 887 GW, Biomass: 46 GW.
- Renewable = **56% of total installed capacity** (record high; 2nd consecutive year >50%).
- 2024 renewable generation: **3.46 trillion kWh**, up 19% YoY, ~**35% of total electricity generated**.
